invariants.note: reuses one canonical kernel and runtime transaction seam
no file, parser, path or unit dependency enters the kernel contract
surface-water parameters, SWST/WLSTAR state, forcing/fluxes, numerics and results remain distinct
persistent state is SWST plus conditional WLSTAR only; WLS is derived
checkpoints, candidates, ledger deltas and solver history are worker/runtime trial objects
feature-active state and DIVDRA materialization can remain sparse/batched
checkpoint-trial-retry-commit/rollback is mandatory and atomic
every retry starts from exact committed checkpoint; trial hints are not physical state
time contract is generic [t0,t1]; explicit events cause interval subdivision
nothing assumes daily or midnight coupling windows
rollback and transaction semantics are first-class rather than retrofit
no groundwater head/flux contract is weakened or redefined
complete physical mass is mandatory; no configurable physical concession
surface-water composition does not suppress upstream physical tangent outputs
composition adds no structural repeated full-column coupling runs
serialized restricted route is composable per column without per-column solver ownership
tile/MODFLOW-area weighting remains runtime/coupler concern outside SWAP process law
deep-vadose transfer remains unrelated and outside surface-water component
no component transition is allowed to discard or duplicate stored water
surface-water transaction contract is independent of a particular Richards implementation
existing drainage/storage/control physics is reused through contracts rather than copied globals
control uses clean hydraulic summaries and no HeadCalc internal arrays
mass/temporal tolerances are numerical policy and do not alter physical branch admission
held branches fail closed; retry cost stays bounded by existing runtime policy
reference/full-accuracy route remains available; D6 does not replace it
accepted/rejected route, retries, completeness mask and mass residual are diagnostics
WLSTAR and DIVDRA scratch/state occur only when their options are active
runtime organizes DIVDRA publication and transaction composition; process laws do not know system topology
no midnight, day, file-format or direct-MODFLOW assumption is introduced
D6 contract explicitly binds and tests all architecture invariants and upstream holds
